name: Garamba National Park
description: Garamba National Park covers nearly 5,200 square kilometres of north-eastern Congo, where rainforest gives way to open savanna. Visitors may see grasslands, papyrus marshes and winding gallery forests, home to forest elephants, Kordofan giraffes, hippos, buffalo and lions. With over 450 bird species recorded, it is one of Africa's oldest parks, though it remains on the List in Danger.
